title: X2.3 Hostile Audit of X2.2 Published Runtime Claims

critical.reality: No jsonschema import. _validate() checks only isinstance(payload, dict) and content_light presence. Schema names stored but never validated. Schema files do not exist at referenced paths.
critical.repair: Implement schema validation before append using jsonschema. Create schema files for all three ledger types.

critical.claim: _evidence.py: 'Thread-safe and process-safe via fcntl advisory locking'
critical.reality: Writer locks .lock file (LOCK_EX). Readers lock data file directly (LOCK_SH). No mutual exclusion between readers and writers.
critical.repair: Lock the same file from both writer and reader paths.

critical.reality: gen_lock wraps only model dict lookup in both generate() and stream_generate(). Actual mlx_lm calls run unlocked.
critical.repair: Extend lock to cover entire generation call, or implement proper scheduler serialization.

critical.reality: Does not call _classify_and_admit() or scan_messages_for_secrets(). Secret-bearing messages pass through streaming path unimpeded.
critical.repair: Run admission gates before streaming, same as execute().

critical.reality: threading.Lock used inside async def. Blocks asyncio event loop on contention.
critical.repair: Use asyncio.Lock or dedicated executor thread.

high.reality: No operation identity, idempotency key, or duplicate detection. Repeated append() creates distinct entries.

high.claim: Schema names referenced in EvidenceLedger constructors
high.reality: No schema files exist at docs/schemas/ for local inference evidence.
No request queue, priority, batching, rate limiting. Only serialized model lookup.
get_cache_policy() returns a policy model. No cache hit/miss tracking, eviction, or reuse.
high.repair: Implement cache authority boundary with truthful status.

high.reality: build_projection() returns raw dict. No typed consumer contract for X0.
threading.Lock used inside async def. Blocks event loop on contention.
high.repair: Use asyncio.Lock or dedicated executor thread.

high.reality: Partial final write raises raw json.JSONDecodeError, not EvidenceLedgerError.

medium.reality: mlx_lm.stream_generate() is synchronous generator. Blocks event loop during token generation.
medium.repair: Run generation in dedicated executor thread.

medium.reality: _extract_content() does not recursively walk nested dicts/arrays.
.build/ is gitignored. No published acceptance artifact exists remotely.
medium.repair: Publish acceptance artifact under committed evidence path.
